metadata.question: Between 2003 and 2019, did global land area covered by crops increase by at least 5 percent?

<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use MODIS Land Cover MCD12Q1 v6.1 (MODIS/061/MCD12Q1), annual global, 2001–2019. Fallback to v6 (MODIS/006/MCD12Q1) if needed.
- Years: 2003 and 2019. Geometry: global rectangle (-180, -60, 180, 85).
2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- No clouds for categorical product. Create cropland mask: LC_Type1 == 12 (Croplands) OR 14 (Cropland/Natural Vegetation Mosaic).
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collection empty for either year after fallback: C1.
- If cropland pixel count == 0 after masking for either year: C2.
- If baseline area is 0 or any result is null/NaN/inf: C3.
- Otherwise compute percent change; >= 5% => A, else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function eeEvaluate(obj) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.evaluate((res, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(res);
    });
  });
}

async function getImageForYear(year) {
  const datasets = ['MODIS/061/MCD12Q1', 'MODIS/006/MCD12Q1'];
  const start = `${year}-01-01`;
  const end = `${year}-12-31`;
  for (let i = 0; i < datasets.length; i++) {
    const ds = datasets[i];
    try {
      const col = ee.ImageCollection(ds).filterDate(start, end);
      const size = await eeEvaluate(col.size());
      if (size && size > 0) {
        return { image: col.first(), dataset: ds, size: size };
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Try next dataset
    }
  }
  return { image: null, dataset: null, size: 0 };
}

function cropMaskFromImage(img) {
  const lc = img.select('LC_Type1');
  const crop = lc.eq(12);
  const cropMosaic = lc.eq(14);
  return crop.or(cropMosaic);
}

async function computeCropStats(img, geom) {
  const mask = cropMaskFromImage(img);
  const areaImg = ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(mask).rename('area');
  const countImg = ee.Image(1).updateMask(mask).rename('mask');

  const areaDict = areaImg.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: 3000,
    maxPixels: 1e13
  });
  const countDict = countImg.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: 3000,
    maxPixels: 1e13
  });

  const area_m2 = await eeEvaluate(ee.Number(areaDict.get('area')));
  const pixels = await eeEvaluate(ee.Number(countDict.get('mask')));

  return {
    area_km2: area_m2 ? area_m2 / 1e6 : null,
    pixels: pixels ? Number(pixels) : 0
  };
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const geom = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, -60, 180, 85], null, false);
    const yearA = 2003;
    const yearB = 2019;

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    const recA = await getImageForYear(yearA);
    const recB = await getImageForYear(yearB);

    console.log(`2003 Dataset: ${recA.dataset || 'None'}, Images: ${recA.size || 0}`);
    console.log(`2019 Dataset: ${recB.dataset || 'None'}, Images: ${recB.size || 0}`);

    if (!recA.image || !recB.image) {
      console.log('Empty collection for one or both years.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing (cropland area and pixel counts)
    const statsA = await computeCropStats(recA.image, geom);
    const statsB = await computeCropStats(recB.image, geom);

    if ((statsA.pixels || 0) === 0 || (statsB.pixels || 0) === 0) {
      console.log('No valid pixels after masking (cropland).');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation
    const areaA = statsA.area_km2;
    const areaB = statsB.area_km2;

    console.log(`2003 Cropland Pixels: ${statsA.pixels}, Area_km2: ${areaA !== null ? areaA.toFixed(0) : 'null'}`);
    console.log(`2019 Cropland Pixels: ${statsB.pixels}, Area_km2: ${areaB !== null ? areaB.toFixed(0) : 'null'}`);

    if (areaA === null || areaB === null || !isFinite(areaA) || !isFinite(areaB) || areaA <= 0) {
      console.log('Invalid area results (null/zero/non-finite).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const delta = areaB - areaA;
    const pct = (delta / areaA) * 100.0;
    console.log(`Change_km2: ${delta.toFixed(0)}, Percent: ${pct.toFixed(2)}%`);

    // 5. Final Answer
    if (!isFinite(pct)) {
      console.log('C3');
    } else if (pct >= 5.0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
